title: The one-step Shafarevich gap in embedding dimension five
summary: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero and let $S=k[x_1,\ldots,x_5]$ with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m=(x_1,\ldots,x_5)$. For a codimension-$r$ subspace $Q\subset S_2$, set $I_Q=(Q)+\mathfrak m^3$. Then $S/I_Q$ has Hilbert function $(1,5,r)$. We prove that the translated one-step locus defined by these ideals is contained in the smoothable component for every $r\in{6,7,\ldots,15}$. We introduce a finite field differential rank certificate proving dominance, for $6\le r\le 14$, of the Erman--Velasco map $\operatorname{GL}*5\times (\mathbb A^5)^r\dashrightarrow…
